messages:
emily: Quick flag 9: draft v2026.4 adds a rule on POC-SK1 treatment. EMEA AEs have customer calls tomorrow; need direction on whether POC usage counts toward annual commit tiers.

raj: Uploaded draft here: https://redwood.internal/rateplans/v2026.4-draft. Main decision: count POC usage as commit credit or treat as non-committal trial?

sam: SE input 9: most enterprise buyers expect POC consumption to be credited if there9s an SOW + PO. Two active POCs would drop below threshold at renewal otherwise.

maya: Deal desk stance 9: we can offer conditional crediting but require clear guardrails and an approval flow. Proposal: credit only if SOW explicitly references the committed SKU AND a PO is received within 30 days of POC start. Mark with #poc-exception for manual review.

emily: That seems reasonable. Customers run real workloads during POC; they want predictability when we request production-like usage. Can you draft the legal language?

raj: Draft clause: `If the customer signs an SOW that references the committed SKU and provides a purchase order within 30 days of the POC start date, usage billed under POC-SK1 during the POC period will be applied to the customer's annual committed units.` Thoughts?

sam: Add requirement that the SOW include POC start/end dates and SKU lines to avoid ops/backfill ambiguity.

maya: Agree. Also add a 90-day review window: deal desk can revoke credit if evidence of misuse appears. Label this a temporary exception for the v2026 patch rollout and log approvals to the approval form.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Rate plan v2026.4 draft published by raj at 2026-03-15 14:02 UTC.

emily: Action items: maya 90 create an approval form and a deal-desk queue; raj update draft and route to legal for fast review; sam list impacted POCs. I need a firm answer by EOD PT so AEs can proceed. :pray:

maya: Will build the templated approval form and the queue item. ETA 5pm PT.

raj: Updating the draft now and will ping legal. If legal requests changes, will escalate.

sam: I'll post the three impacted POC records in a separate thread and tag them for review.

emily: Thanks all. If legal signs off quickly, we9ll ship the exception note in the v2026.4 patch and add a short AE playbook blurb.
